records.name: Policy Repo Rate
records.description: Key benchmark policy rate at which the RBI lends short-term funds to scheduled commercial banks against government securities under the Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF).
records.impactOnBorrower: External benchmark anchor for retail floating-rate home loans, personal loans, and MSME borrowing across all scheduled banks.

records.name: Standing Deposit Facility (SDF)
records.changeDisplay: Fixed 25 bps below Policy Repo Rate
records.description: Collateral-free standing liquidity absorption facility allowing eligible commercial banks to park excess liquidity with the RBI without requiring government collateral.
records.impactOnBorrower: Sets the operating lower bound for the weighted average call money rate (WACR) corridor in the interbank market.

records.name: Marginal Standing Facility (MSF)
records.changeDisplay: Fixed 25 bps above Policy Repo Rate
records.description: Penal overnight borrowing facility under which scheduled commercial banks can borrow emergency funds from the RBI by dipping into their Statutory Liquidity Ratio (SLR) portfolio up to approved limits.
records.impactOnBorrower: Acts as the ceiling of the policy interest rate corridor, capping spikes in interbank overnight borrowing costs.

records.name: Bank Rate
records.description: Standard discount rate at which the RBI is prepared to buy or rediscount bills of exchange or other commercial paper eligible for purchase under the RBI Act.
records.impactOnBorrower: Directly determines penal interest rates charged by the RBI on banks for shortfalls in meeting reserve requirements (CRR/SLR).

records.name: Fixed Reverse Repo Rate
records.description: Fixed interest rate at which the RBI absorbs liquidity on a collateralized basis from scheduled commercial banks under the LAF window.
records.impactOnBorrower: Provides a secondary baseline floor for money market short-term yields and commercial paper rates.

records.name: Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR)
records.description: Specified minimum percentage of a commercial bank Net Demand and Time Liabilities (NDTL) that must be maintained with the RBI in cash balances on an average daily basis without earning interest.
records.impactOnBorrower: Directly influences total loanable funds available to banking institutions, impacting credit supply and deposit competition.

records.name: Statutory Liquidity Ratio (SLR)
records.description: Mandatory minimum percentage of NDTL that every commercial bank must maintain in liquid assets (predominantly Central and State Government dated securities, treasury bills, and gold).
records.impactOnBorrower: Guarantees bank solvency, cushions against run-on-bank systemic risks, and creates structural demand for sovereign debt issuance.

records.name: Standing Liquidity Facility Base Rate (Base Rate)
records.effectiveDate: Replaced for new loans; applies to grandfathered accounts
records.governingAct: RBI Guidelines on Base Rate System (2010)
records.description: Minimum interest rate below which scheduled commercial banks were prohibited from lending to any borrower, superseded by MCLR in 2016 and EBLR in 2019.
records.impactOnBorrower: Applicable to older pre-2016 corporate and mortgage advances that have not migrated to EBLR.

records.name: Marginal Cost of Funds based Lending Rate (MCLR - 1 Year)
records.description: Internal benchmark calculated by banks based on marginal cost of funds, negative carry on CRR/SLR, operating costs, and tenor premium.
records.impactOnBorrower: Governs corporate credit lines and legacy housing loans sanctioned between April 2016 and September 2019.
